extraction.name: PASTIS (Panoptic Agricultural Satellite TIme Series)
extraction.description: A large-scale dataset for panoptic segmentation of agricultural parcels from satellite image time series, comprised of 2,433 sequences of multi-spectral images with semantic and instance annotations covering over 4000 km² across four regions of France.
extraction.creator: Vivien Sainte Fare Gamot, Loic Landrieu
extraction.publisher: LASTIG, Univ. Gustave Eiffel, ENSG, IGN
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Multi-spectral satellite images collected from Sentinel-2 satellite after atmospheric correction and re-sampling at 10 meters per pixel spatial resolution. Acquisitions with extensive cloud cover were automatically filtered by the satellite data provider THEIA.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Close to 28% of images have at least partial cloud cover. The time between acquisitions is uneven with a median of 5 days due to automatic filtering of acquisitions with extensive cloud cover.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Sentinel-2 satellite multi-spectral images provided by THEIA satellite data provider, covering four different regions of France.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Atmospheric correction and re-sampling at a spatial resolution of 10 meters per pixel. Automatic filtering of acquisitions with extensive cloud cover by the satellite data provider THEIA.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Each pixel is associated with a semantic label from a nomenclature of 18 crop types plus a background class. Each non-background pixel has a unique instance label corresponding to its parcel index. All annotations are taken from the publicly available French Land Parcel Identification System.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The French Payment Agency estimates the accuracy of the crop annotations via in situ control over 98% and the relative error in terms of surfaces under 0.3%.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset is split into 5 folds, chosen with a 1km buffer between images to avoid cross-fold contamination.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Geography (four different regions of France with diverse climates and crop distributions)
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Remote monitoring of the surface and nature of agricultural parcels is necessary for a fair allocation of agricultural subsidies (50 and 22 billion euros per year in Europe and in the US, respectively) and for ensuring that best crop rotation practices are respected.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset is highly unbalanced, with a ratio of over 50 between the most and least common classes.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Close to 28% of images have at least partial cloud cover. The combination of ambiguous borders and hard-to-classify parcel content makes for a challenging panoptic segmentation problem. Identifying crop types and parcel borders from a single image at the resolution of Sentinel-2 is particularly difficult.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, and Validation for panoptic segmentation of agricultural parcels. The dataset is designed for crop mapping, remote monitoring of agricultural parcels for fair allocation of agricultural subsidies, and ensuring best crop rotation practices are respected.

name.evidence: We present PASTIS (Panoptic Agricultural Satellite TIme Series), the first large-scale, publicly available SITS dataset with both semantic and panoptic annotations.

description.evidence: PASTIS is comprised of 2 433 sequences of multi-spectral images of shape 10×128×128. Each sequence contains between 38and61observations taken between September 2018 and November 2019, for a total of over 2 billion pixels. The dataset spans over 4000 km2, with images taken from four different regions of France with diverse climates and crop distributions, covering almost 1%of the French Metropolitan territory.
